'''Massan''' was the native language of [[Kallidahin/Legends|Kallidahins]], also known as Polis Massans. Since they had no vocal cords, this language was a sign language, which, combined with [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]], allowed them to communicate with each other. The language fell outside of the normal audio range of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] species.<ref name="Enhancement" />
